realm_description: The high, thin-aired peaks where thought is clearest. Those drawn here chase vision, discovery, and the kind of knowledge that only comes from climbing higher than everyone else.

primary.label: Visionary
primary.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
primary.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
primary.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

secondary.label: Oracle
secondary.description: Notices what hasn't happened yet — through a mind that sees connections others miss.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will speak the pattern I see, even when no one wants to hear it yet.
secondary.shadow_description: Mistakes a hunch for a prophecy, and loses the trust of anyone who asks for proof.

wheel.central_question: Should we imagine tomorrow, or preserve yesterday?

other_ally.label: Judge
other_ally.description: Weighs fairness deliberately; authority must be earned, not assumed.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I hold the scale steady, even when the verdict costs me.
other_ally.shadow_description: Hides behind the letter of the rule to avoid the harder, human work of mercy.

quarter.label: Philosopher
quarter.description: Chases understanding for its own sake, deeper than any single answer.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will not stop asking until the world reveals what it truly is.
quarter.shadow_description: Keeps asking the next question until the moment for an answer has already passed.

opposite.label: Custodian
opposite.description: Refuses to let a tradition, language, or way of life slip away; care is not nostalgia but stubborn devotion.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will hold on to what matters, long after others have let it go.
trait_descriptions: Some things must not be lost.
opposite.shadow_description: Guards the tradition so fiercely that nothing — not even necessary growth — is allowed through.
